digo_source: Pakia 2005 Appendix III ('Mkoko bara'; 'hinterland mkoko', not classed among mikoko)

teaser.en: Its Digo name calls it a mangrove of the mainland, yet the Digo do not count it among the mangroves at all.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linauita mkoko wa bara, lakini Wadigo hawauhesabu kabisa miongoni mwa mikoko.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinauiha mkoko wa bara, ela Adigo taauolanga kahi ya *mikoko* kabisa.

summary.en: *Mkoko bara*, the white milkwood, is an evergreen tree with milky sap and dark berries that grows in bushland and dune thicket behind the shore. Its name is a small lesson in how Digo plant names work.
summary.sw: *Mkoko bara* (kwa Kiingereza *white milkwood*) ni mti usiopukutisha majani wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na beri za rangi nzito, unaoota katika vichaka na vichaka vya matuta ya mchanga nyuma ya ufuo. Jina lake ni somo dogo kuhusu jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanavyofanya kazi.
summary.dg: *Mkoko bara* (kpwa Chingereza *white milkwood*) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye maziya na matunda madide maru, unaomera weruni na kahi ya vitsaka vya vilima vya mtsanga nyuma ya pwani. Dzinare ni fundzo dide ra ivyo madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganavyohenda kazi.

about.en:
*Mkoko bara* is an evergreen coastal tree, often shrubby and dense in exposed places, with thick, leathery dark-green leaves. Break a leaf or twig and it bleeds white, milky latex, which is where the English name milkwood comes from.

Its small flowers are greenish-white and clustered along the stems, and they are followed by round berries that ripen to dark purple or black. The berries are eaten by birds.
about.sw:
*Mkoko bara* ni mti wa pwani usiopukutisha majani, mara nyingi wenye umbo la kichaka na msongamano mahali palipo wazi kwa upepo, na majani manene ya kijani kibichi kama ngozi. Ukivunja jani au kitawi, hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, na hapo ndipo lilipotoka jina la Kiingereza *milkwood*.

Maua yake madogo ni meupe yenye kijani kidogo na yamejikusanya kando ya vitawi, na hufuatwa na beri za mviringo zinazoiva na kuwa za zambarau nzito au nyeusi. Beri hizo huliwa na ndege.
about.dg:
*Mkoko bara* ni muhi wa pwani wenye makodza chila wakati; phatu phenye phepho kali kpwa kawaida unakala dza chitsaka chirichogbwirana. Una makodza maziho, magumu dza chingo, ga chijani sana. Uchigbwanyula kodza au liphungo, rinalavya maziya, na ndiko dzina ra Chingereza *milkwood* rinakotuluka.

Maruwage madide ni ga rangi nyereru yenye chijani chidide, na ganamera kpwa mafungu kanda-kanda ya pandaze. Badaye kunatuluka matunda ga mviringo ganayoivwa na kukala ga zambarau sana au maru. Matunda higa nkuriwa ni nyuni.

where.en: Despite its name, it does not grow in the tidal mud. Look for it in coastal bushland and dune thicket just behind the shore, where wind and salt spray shape the trees into low, rounded crowns.
where.sw: Licha ya jina lake, hauoti kwenye tope la maji kupwa na kujaa. Utaupata katika vichaka vya pwani na vichaka vya matuta ya mchanga nyuma tu ya ufuo, ambapo upepo na manyunyu ya chumvi huifinyanga miti kuwa na vilele vifupi vya mviringo.
where.dg: Hata dzinare richikala ni mkoko, taumera kpwenye matope ga madzi ga bahari. Uhendze weruni pwani na kahi ya vitsaka vya vilima vya mtsanga nyuma ya pwani, ambapho phepho na munyu wa bahari vinahenda dzulu ya mihi ikale fupi na ya mviringo.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded for it among the Digo so far.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Hadi sambi takuna kazi iriyoandikpwa ya muhi uhu kahi ya Adigo.

culture.en: The name joins *mkoko*, mangrove, with *bara*, the mainland or hinterland: roughly 'the inland mangrove'. Yet the Digo do not count it among the *mikoko*. Pakia uses it as an example of how a shared name does not mean a shared category: the tree borrows the mangrove's name without belonging to the mangrove family of trees.
culture.sw: Jina hili linaunganisha *mkoko*, yaani mkoko wa pwani, na *bara*, yaani nchi kavu au bara: kwa kukadiria 'mkoko wa bara'. Hata hivyo Wadigo hawauhesabu miongoni mwa *mikoko*. Pakia anautumia kama mfano wa jinsi jina la pamoja lisivyomaanisha kundi la pamoja: mti huu unaazima jina la mkoko bila kuwa sehemu ya jamii ya mikoko.
culture.dg: Dzina rina *mkoko*, mkoko, na *bara*, tsi kavu au kanda ya ndani kure na pwani: manage ni dza 'mkoko wa bara'. Ela Adigo taauolanga kahi ya *mikoko*. Pakia anauhumira dza mfwano wa kuonyesa kukala dzina rimwenga tarimaanisha kundi rimwenga: muhi uhu unahala dzina ra mkoko, ela tauri kahi ya kundi ra mikoko.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkoko bara*, the 'hinterland *mkoko*'. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mkoko* (plural *mikoko*) as mangrove or mangrove pole, used in building. No Swahili name has been recorded. In English it is the white milkwood, and its scientific name is *Sideroxylon inerme*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkoko bara*, yaani '*mkoko* wa bara'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mkoko* (wingi *mikoko*) kwa maana ya mkoko au boriti ya mkoko, inayotumika katika ujenzi. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *white milkwood*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Sideroxylon inerme*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mkoko bara*, '*mkoko* wa bara'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mkoko* (wingi *mikoko*) dza mkoko au nguzo ya mkoko ya kudzengera. Dzina ra Chiswahili taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *white milkwood*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sideroxylon inerme*.

reason.sw: Familia moja yenye utomvu kama maziwa (Sapotaceae)
reason.dg: Jamii imwenga ya mihi yenye maziya (Sapotaceae)

reason.sw: Huota katika vichaka vilevile nyuma ya ufuo
reason.dg: Unamera kahi ya vitsaka vimwenga nyuma ya pwani
